title: Summers with kin in the country
summary: He spent summers until age twenty-one with his mother's relatives, hunting and riding, until he preferred the music business.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: pretty good with horses...'cause I, in the meantime, my people...my kinfolk live up in the country, so in the summertime, my momma would send me up there. We'd go up in the country, have a ball, goin' huntin' and run everybody's horses crazy, tryin' to ride 'em. Every summer I used to go up there till I got to be about twenty-one years old. And then I got old enough where I could get into nightclubs. My mother want to send me up in the country; I didn't want to go. I want to get into the music business.

So I finally went up and stayed a couple of weeks an' tore 'bout to bug everybody to death, so finally I come back home. My mother asked me did I have a good time. I go, "Yeah, I had a ball. I had a good time, ridin' all the horses, goin' huntin' with the dog, runnin' up and down the meadows."
So I had an auntie. She...when I'd go visit...she had about ten children. She had a couple of girls. The rest of 'em was all boys. So I had a good time with them.
